entry.title: What actually breaks when you put AI agents in production
entry.summary: Demos lie. An AI agent that books a meeting, queries an API, and summarizes the result in a slick demo is maybe 20% of the work. The other 80% is everything that happens when the same agent meets a real user, real data, and a Tuesday afternoon when an upstream API is having a bad day. We build multi-agent systems for companies for a living, and the gap between "works in the notebook" and "works in production" is where most AI projects quietly die. Here are the failure modes we see most often — and what we actually do about them. A single LLM call has no idea when it's hallucinating.
